scope: Display-only asset names and PNG logos for signed Spot/Futures balances

prd.requirement: Join canonical balance asset code to public asset metadata for names and icons

mapping.join: Case-normalized exact asset code; asBNB -> ASBNB; no inferred aliases
mapping.names: English/Chinese preferred by locale with available-name fallback; missing names retain canonical selectable symbol
mapping.unrelated_rows: Skip space-containing protocol/points labels, never invent account symbols
mapping.validation: Bounded envelope and names; reject case collisions, controls and malformed identifiers
mapping.financial_boundary: Ignore assetDigit, price, gas, precision, token addresses and permissions; metadata never changes signed identifiers, balance quantities or valuations

transport.abort: AbortableRequest on timeout and service disposal; queued images do not start after close
transport.image_type: PNG signature/IHDR and image/png; fixed HTTPS static.astherus.finance image/admin_mgs_image_upload path only
transport.image_cache: Success-only LRU, 64 entries / 4 MiB, per-URI request sharing, manual eviction/retry

lifecycle: Independent names/logos source state, shared across Spot/Futures, 15-minute freshness, no polling/retry loop. Background discards late catalog results; resume reuses fresh data or refreshes missing/expired nonfailed sources. Failed sources require manual retry. Original symbol and fallback icon remain usable.
acceptance_limits: Official public frontend endpoints have no stable third-party developer contract
Observed name source omits USDF/asBNB names; logo source covers them; unavailable names are not synthesized
Anonymous catalog and CDN observations do not verify real balances, private permissions or native rendering
No real wallet/signing/RPC/private/account/financial/device request; one anonymous read-only public POST was used
